_kommentar: Für jeden Klang: Gruppe, ein Suchbegriff für Klangarchive, der Prompt, mit
dem die vorliegende Datei erzeugt wurde, und die angestrebte Länge.
Der Prompt ist der WIRKLICH verwendete - wer eine Datei neu erzeugen will,
bekommt damit dasselbe wieder. Drei mussten mehrfach erzeugt werden, weil
die Messung sie verworfen hat; hier steht der Prompt des Treffers.
Die Zuordnung zu Geschichten steht NICHT hier - die rechnet
scripts/einkaufsliste.mjs aus den Geschichten aus, damit die Liste nicht

esel.prompt: One short friendly hee-haw from a donkey, recorded outdoors on a farm, close microphone, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Warm and gentle, a contented donkey greeting someone, not strained or distressed. Just one bray, about one second, then silence.

hund_bellen.prompt: One friendly medium-sized dog barking twice, recorded outdoors close to the microphone, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Cheerful and welcoming, not aggressive.

katze_miau.prompt: A soft house cat meowing once, close, gentle, dry with no reverb, no music.

hahn_kikeriki.prompt: A rooster crowing once, clear, farmyard, dry with no reverb, no music.

schwein_grunz.prompt: A pig grunting and snuffling contentedly, recorded close in a barn, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Round and comical, a happy pig.

kuh_muh.prompt: A cow mooing once, calm and low, recorded in a meadow close to the microphone, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

schaf_maeh.prompt: A goat bleating once, light and a little funny, recorded close outdoors, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

maus_piep.prompt: A tiny mouse squeaking twice, very small and high, recorded very close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Sweet, not shrill.

loewe_bruell.prompt: A lion roaring once, deep and powerful but short, recorded outdoors, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Impressive rather than frightening, suitable for a children's story.

eule_ruf.prompt: An owl hooting twice at night, soft and round, recorded at a little distance in a quiet forest, no music. Calm and reassuring.

wal_ruf.prompt: A humpback whale calling underwater, one long gentle song rising and falling, muffled and spacious, no music.

drache_brumm.prompt: A big friendly creature rumbling deep in its chest, low and warm, like a huge sleepy animal humming, recorded close, no music. Cosy, absolutely not scary.

frosch_quak.prompt: A frog croaking twice by a pond, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Round and friendly.

wolf_knurren.prompt: A short low growl, restrained and grumpy rather than threatening, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. For a wolf in a children's fairy tale, must not frighten a three-year-old.

summen.prompt: A single bee buzzing past the microphone, soft and light, approaching and moving away, recorded outdoors, no music.

gespenst_huu.prompt: A playful cartoon ghost going oooooh, light and funny like a child pretending to be a ghost, recorded close, no music. Clearly comical, not frightening at all.

gaehnen.prompt: A sleepy child yawning once, soft and natural, recorded close to the microphone, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

schnarchen.prompt: Two gentle comical snores, soft and slow, someone fast asleep, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

hau_ruck.prompt: One short effort grunt from someone pulling hard on something heavy, a hearty heave-ho, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

schluckauf.prompt: Three clear funny hiccups in a row, one after another with only a short gap, loud and close to the microphone, dry with no reverb, no music. The hiccups fill the whole clip, no silence.

schritte.prompt: Four calm footsteps on a wooden floor, unhurried, recorded close indoors, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

glitzern.prompt: A soft magical sparkle, delicate bells and glitter shimmering gently upward, warm and dreamy, no music, no melody.

plumps.prompt: Something soft and heavy landing on grass with a round woody thud, then a brief rustle of grass settling. Loud and close to the microphone, dry with no reverb, no music. The sound starts immediately.

klopfen.prompt: Three knocks on a wooden door, friendly and even, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music.

tuer_knarr.prompt: An old wooden door creaking slowly open, one long creak, recorded close, clean and dry with no reverb, no music. Clearly audible, cosy old house rather than horror film.

wasser_platsch.prompt: A small splash in water, one stone dropping into a pond, recorded close, clean and dry, no music.

blubbern.prompt: A pot of thick porridge bubbling gently on the stove, slow fat bubbles, recorded close in a kitchen, no music.

feuer_knistern.prompt: A small fire crackling in a fireplace, warm pops and snaps, recorded close, no music.

pusten.prompt: Someone blowing hard once, a single big puff of air straight at the microphone, clean and dry, no music.

wind_boe.prompt: A single gust of wind rising and fading away, soft and round, recorded outdoors, no music, no howling.

rollen.prompt: A large round pancake rolling fast across a wooden floor, loud and close, a rumbling wooden roll, dry with no reverb, no music. Full and clearly audible throughout.

uhr_ticken.prompt: An old wall clock ticking slowly and steadily, recorded close in a quiet room, clean and dry, no music, no chimes.

donner.prompt: Distant soft thunder rolling slowly away, low and round with no sharp crack, no music. Gentle enough for a small child.

bagger_motor.prompt: A small digger engine starting up and settling into an idle, friendly diesel chug, recorded outdoors, no music.

rakete_start.prompt: A rocket lifting off, deep rumble building up and then moving away into the distance, no music, no voices.

zug_pfiff.prompt: A steam locomotive whistle, two short friendly toots, recorded outdoors at a little distance, no music.

tag.prompt: A calm sunny meadow atmosphere, clearly present and audible: small birds singing in the distance, a light breeze moving through leaves and grass. Even and continuous from start to finish, no music, no voices, no sudden sounds.

nacht.prompt: Loud close summer night field recording: a dense chorus of crickets chirping continuously, right next to the microphone, full and strong throughout. Continuous from the first instant to the last, no music, no voices.

innen.prompt: Loud close room ambience inside an old wooden cottage: a steady airy hiss of a draught, faint settling creaks of wood, full and strong throughout. Continuous from the first instant to the last, no music, no voices.

wasser.prompt: A calm underwater ambience, muffled and round, slow deep water with a few distant soft bubbles. Even background atmosphere, no music, no whale calls, no sudden sounds.
